definitions.explanation: To reduce food such as vegetables or spices to fine pieces using a grater or similar tool, typically moving in a back-and-forth or circular motion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{下|お}ろす。
⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{下|お}ろして⟦{薬味|やくみ}→薬味：04964_yakumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I grate ginger to use as a condiment.

examples.japanese: ⟦リンゴ→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{下|お}ろして⟦{離乳食|りにゅうしょく}→離乳食：14883_rinyuushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I grated an apple to make baby food.

notes:
USAGE: すり{下|お}ろす is a godan verb commonly used in cooking contexts. It is a compound verb combining ⟦すり→すり：01330_suri⟧ (from {擦|す}る, to rub) and ⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧ (to move downward), describing the downward rubbing motion of grating.

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive (takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧)

ASPECT: すり{下|お}ろして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates the action of grating in progress.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{下|お}ろす (to grate daikon radish)
- ⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{下|お}ろす (to grate ginger)
- ⟦{山葵|わさび}→山葵：05121_wasabi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{下|お}ろす (to grate wasabi)
- ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{下|お}ろす (to grate carrot)
- ⟦{林檎|りんご}→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{下|お}ろす (to grate apple)

KANJI NOTE: Often written in hiragana as すりおろす. Can also be written as {擦|す}り{下|お}ろす.

RELATED NOUN: すり{下|お}ろし refers to the grated food itself, especially ⟦{大根|だいこん}おろし→大根おろし：26890_daikonoroshi⟧ (grated daikon).
